name: 笹缶よもや
description:
Illustratorのよもやです。
雑多に絵を描きます、最近はデュエマメイン。
ちょくちょくスペースでイイ声をバラまいてたり…。

works.body:
Hi Yomoya-san!

Would yiu like to try drawing me?

I'm not really sure what I'd like, but I think we share simillar interests.

If Yomoya-san has fun, I'm sure i will enjoy it.

I have many outfits in my references that you are free to draw inspiration from, but you're also free to dress me uo however you like.

If you would like to draw something inspired from Japanese anime or manga, my favorites include Yu-Gi-Oh!, Naruto, Bleach, and My Hero Academia. I also like Genshin Impact and the Fate/ series

I also like comefy, slice of life, and romance genres too. A casual or emotional scene would be refreshing.

I love taking walks, playing video games, going to the gym, and all kinds of animals. Animal features on vtubers are really cute and cool.

Sorry for talking so much. Please enjoy your time!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1F7VL1l6TSkAJ7csdTbxr-5t7YTCEyQz5

Sasa Can Yomoya Sama

It is nice to meet you.
I was browsing skeb when I came across your page, and I saw your illustrations on X as well!
I really like your manga-like style, your penmanship, and the way you draw the lines of the body!
I was wondering if you could draw my child, so I sent a request...!
I would like to leave the composition and situation to you, but I would appreciate it if you could draw any area from the bottom of the chest to the whole body in an unsafe atmosphere...!
We would appreciate it if the file format for delivery is PSD.
I would appreciate your consideration.
Thank you very much in advance.
Please take care of yourself and enjoy the hot weather...!

Hello, Sasa Can Yomoya-san!
I really liked your keynary the other day.
I will send you a request, if you don't mind, please consider it.

Could you please draw my daughters, Fukabami and Kamichi?
I can draw them together or individually, or if it's too difficult, I can draw one of them.

We will leave everything up to you, including the specific composition, situation, and costumes.
Both of them should have breasts, no matter how big they are, but please make sure they are not too small.

Thank you in advance!
